author: Joe Scott
description:
The Patterson-Gimlin film has officially been debunked. After over 50 years of debate, new footage has been discovered that blows the whole thing out of the water. That footage was the subject of a new documentary called Capturing Bigfoot. I got to sit down with the film’s director, Marq Evans to talk about the Patterson family, the scheme that got out of control, and the surprising brilliance of Roger Patterson, possibly the greatest hoaxer of all time.

See Capturing Bigfoot on Amazon Prime: https://www.amazon.com/Capturing-Bigfoot-Marq-Evans/dp/B0HKZGLG71/ref=sr_1_1
